info.title: Local Report Review Studio
info.description: Local extraction and evidence-linked review. Synthetic demonstration, not a medical device. AI mock is default. Live endpoint fixed to BigModel Coding Plan; GLM_API_KEY server environment only. Every AI request requires one-use preview, exact anchor IDs and informed consent. Upload processing uses a bounded background queue.
